title: Graph Label Alignment: A Diagnostic Atlas for Graph Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.14760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph classification benchmarks vary widely in difficulty: some are solved by simple pooled baselines, while others remain challenging for GNNs and graph transformers. We take a data-centric view and ask whether benchmark success is driven by genuine structure--feature reasoning or by label signal already accessible from restricted marginal views. We introduce graph label alignment, a lightweight diagnostic that measures label accessibility through two supervised probes computed without training a graph encoder: structural label alignment (SLA), based on permutation-invariant topological and spectral summaries, and feature label alignment (FLA), based on pooled node features with edges removed. Across real graph classification benchmarks and multiple pooled backbones, the resulting SLA--FLA plane strongly organizes test accuracy, with low-alignment datasets forming a consistent regime where standard pooled pipelines struggle. To probe

translated_title: 图标签对齐：图分类的诊断图谱
translated_abstract: 图分类基准的难度差异很大：有些基准用简单的池化基线即可解决，而另一些对图神经网络（GNN）和图Transformer而言仍具挑战性。我们采取以数据为中心的视角，探究基准测试上的成功究竟是由真实的结构-特征推理所驱动，还是由受限边缘视角下已经可获取的标签信号所驱动。我们提出图谱标签对齐这一轻量级诊断方法，通过两个无需训练图编码器的监督探针来衡量标签可获取性：结构标签对齐（SLA），基于置换不变的拓扑与谱摘要；特征标签对齐（FLA），基于移除边后的池化节点特征。在真实图分类基准和多种池化骨干网络上，所得的SLA-FLA平面能够强烈地组织测试准确率，其中低对齐数据集形成了一个标准池化流水线难以应对的一致性区域。为了探究……
tldr: 该论文提出图谱标签对齐（包含SLA与FLA两个无需训练图编码器的监督探针）这一轻量级诊断工具，其SLA-FLA平面能有效刻画图分类基准的难度，并识别出标准池化方法难以应对的低标签对齐数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces graph label alignment (SLA and FLA), a lightweight diagnostic with two supervised probes that measure label accessibility without training a graph encoder, showing that the SLA-FLA plane strongly organizes benchmark difficulty and identifies low-alignment datasets where standard pooled pipelines struggle.
